episodes.title_en: COLD OPEN — THE BOY WHO WOULD BE LOKI

beats.voiceover_en: [NARRATOR]: Before the saga begins — WHO IS THE BOY? — Kratos stands at the edge of Midgard frost wilds.
beats.voiceover_ml: [നറേട്റർ]: ആ കുട്ടി ആരാണ്? — തുറക്കൽ — ലോക്കിയാകാൻ പോകുന്ന കുട്ടി. ഇന്നും ഇകയാണം കഥാപ്രസംഗം തടംഗുന്നു!
beats.visual: Kratos heroic low angle in Midgard frost wilds

beats.voiceover_en: [NARRATOR]: Midgard frost wilds breathes smoke and fate — Kratos will not retreat.
beats.voiceover_ml: [നറേറ്റർ]: കാൽപ്പാടുകൾ മഞ്ഞിൽ അരിയുന്നു; ഓരോ ചുവടും ഒരു പഴയ പാപത്തിന്റെ ഓർമ്മ.
beats.visual: wide establishing shot of Midgard frost wilds storm sky day 1

beats.voiceover_en: [KRATOS]: I did not come this far to kneel on day 1.
beats.voiceover_ml: [ക്രാറ്റോസ്]: മുട്ടുകുത്താൻ വന്നതല്ല... മകനെ നിരത്താൻ.
beats.visual: Kratos mid battle against shadows in Midgard frost wilds

beats.voiceover_en: [ODIN]: Then bleed again, hero — Midgard frost wilds remembers every coward.
beats.voiceover_ml: [ഓഡിൻ]: നീ think you can hide from fate? Midgard belongs to my ravens!
beats.visual: Odin villain reveal fire backlight

beats.voiceover_en: [ATREUS]: Stand up. We finish day 1 together.
beats.voiceover_ml: [അത്രേയസ്]: അച്ഛാ, ഞാൻ പേടിക്കുന്നില്ല — നമ്മൾ ഒന്നിച്ച്.
beats.visual: Atreus and Kratos stand back to back

beats.voiceover_en: [NARRATOR]: Steel clashes; the ground remembers every footstep on day 1.
beats.voiceover_ml: [നറേറ്റർ]: Leviathan axe-ന്റെ നീല തീ പോലെ, പitaavinte krodham prajwalanikkunnu.
beats.visual: Kratos running through burning ruins

beats.voiceover_en: [KRATOS]: My pain is my weapon now — watch me on day 1.
beats.voiceover_ml: [ക്രാറ്റോസ്]: എന്റെ vaydu enikku weapon aayi — adhuvum enikku path aayi.
beats.visual: close up Kratos face rage and tears

beats.voiceover_en: [NARRATOR]: Memory returns — sweet, cruel, necessary — day 1 demands truth.
beats.voiceover_ml: [നറേറ്റർ]: Freyya-yude shaapam kaattil whisper cheyyunnu — maathru hrudayam oru yudham.
beats.visual: vision of past memory ghostly overlay

beats.voiceover_en: [KRATOS]: For Kerala. For every soul who believed — day 1 is ours.
beats.voiceover_ml: [ക്രാറ്റോസ്]: Ragnarok varumbol, naan muzhuvan thalarnnittum nikkum — enikku oru puthran und.
beats.visual: Kratos final strike slow motion day 1

beats.voiceover_en: [ODIN]: You win today... but day 2 takes everything.
beats.voiceover_ml: [ഓഡിൻ]: Win today, Spartan... tomorrow the wolf eats your sky.
beats.visual: Odin falls or escapes cliffhanger

beats.voiceover_en: [NARRATOR]: Silence falls over Midgard frost wilds — but not for long.
beats.voiceover_ml: [നറേറ്റർ]: Yudhathinte shesham, nishabdham oru prathijna pole — naale oru puthiya lokam.
beats.visual: wide Midgard frost wilds dawn after battle

beats.voiceover_en: [NARRATOR]: Tomorrow changes everything. Do not miss day 2.
beats.voiceover_ml: [നറേറ്റർ]: Innu divasam 1 — naale nammal thirike varum. Ragnarok thudarunnu.
beats.visual: Kratos walks toward camera epic finale
